title: حساب بی حساب
description: Hisaab Barabar is a 2024 Indian Hindi-language comedy thriller film written and directed by Ashwni Dhir. The film stars R. Madhavan in the lead role, with Neil Nitin Mukesh, Kirti Kulhari, Rashami Desai, and Faisal Rashid in supporting roles. The story follows a railway ticket checker who uncovers discrepancies in minor bank transactions, which leads him to uncover deeper systemic corruption. The film is produced by Jio Studios and SP Cinecorp. The film premiered at the 55th International Film Festival of India in Goa on 26 November 2024 and was released on 24 January 2025 on ZEE5.
